给外籍专业人士、经理与高管（PMET）的全职工作准证，由雇主申请，无国籍限制。两: A full-time work pass for foreign professionals, managers and executives (PMETs), applied for by the employer, with no nationality restriction. Eligibility runs in two stages: the first gate is salary — the monthly salary must meet the EP threshold for your age band (from S$5,600 at age 23 and under to S$10,700 at age 45 and over), and the second gate is the COMPASS points assessment. You must clear both to qualify. From 2027-01-01 the thresholds rise by one band (from S$6,000 at age 23 and under to S$11,500 at age 45 and over), so anyone negotiating salary now must look at the new table.
EP 的两阶段资格按薪资与 COMPASS 打分判定，未按国籍设限；中国大陆护照: EP eligibility is decided in two stages, on salary and on the COMPASS score, with no limit set by nationality; a mainland Chinese passport can apply. The real constraints are whether a Singapore employer is willing to hire you at a qualifying salary, and the COMPASS score — both of which are tied to the employer.
官方不设年龄上下限，但年龄直接决定薪资门槛：23 岁及以下最低 S$5,600，: The official rules set no minimum or maximum age, but age directly determines the salary threshold: S$5,600 at age 23 and under, rising by a fixed band for each additional year, up to S$10,700 at age 45 and over. So age is not a question of whether you may apply, but of how much you must be paid to qualify. A value of 0–99 means there is no age threshold, not that it is to be verified.
官方资格判定不单看学历，而是综合薪资与 COMPASS（含学历项）。本字段按 b: Official eligibility is not decided on qualifications alone but on salary and COMPASS together (which includes a qualification item). This field is recorded as bachelor_completed, a conservative reading: in practice a degree holder is more likely to meet the salary and scoring requirements, but the official rules do not state that a bachelor degree is a single hard requirement. Run the numbers in the MOM Self-Assessment Tool before submitting.
官方资格清单未设英语考试要求。COMPASS 的语言相关项（如员工国籍多样性）是: The official eligibility list sets no English test requirement. The language-related COMPASS items (such as the diversity of employee nationalities) are diversity indicators on the employer side, not a language score for the applicant.
不要求申请人自证存款。门槛全部体现在「雇主支付的月薪」上，见 timeline: Applicants are not required to prove savings. The threshold is expressed entirely through the monthly salary the employer pays; see the age bands in timeline and risks.
须有新加坡雇主提供的工作 offer 并由雇主递交申请。雇主还须先满足公平考量框: You need a job offer from a Singapore employer, and the employer lodges the application. The employer must also first meet the Fair Consideration Framework (FCF) job advertising requirement: `Employers must continue to meet the Fair Consideration Framework (FCF) job advertising requirement before submitting new EP applications.`
学历证明是 COMPASS 打分与材料审核的一部分，不是「在读」要求；已毕业者提: Proof of qualifications is part of COMPASS scoring and document review, not an enrolment requirement; graduates simply submit the degree certificate and transcripts.
EP 与同国 S Pass 的关键差别就在这里：官方对 EP 未设配额门槛，用的: This is the key difference between the EP and the S Pass in the same country: the official rules set no quota for the EP, which uses the twin gates of salary and COMPASS scoring instead; the S Pass is the one subject to a quota and a labour levy. Hence the EP is recorded as no_quota and the S Pass as capped (concurrent).
无窗口，由雇主随时递交；但有一个与日期强相关的政策节点：2027-01-01 起: No window — the employer may lodge at any time; but there is one policy date that matters: from 2027-01-01 the salary thresholds rise by one band across the board.
rolling：官方无开放窗口或名额。lead_time_days=60 的依据: rolling: there is no official opening window and no places. lead_time_days=60 is based on the employer first running the FCF job advertising process (usually a 14-day posting) and then preparing the COMPASS scoring documents and qualification verification, which together need about 2 months to be safe. date_confidence is recorded as unknown because with no window there is no date whose reliability is in question — not because the research was incomplete.
全年滚动受理。当前（2026-11-11 核实）薪资门槛为：23 岁及以下 S$: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis all year. As at 2026-11-11 (verified), the salary thresholds are S$5,600 at age 23 and under and S$10,700 at age 45 and over, rising year by year in between; the financial services sector has a further band (S$6,200 to S$11,800).
**2027-01-01 起门槛上调**：新申请一律按新表（23 岁及以下 S$: **Thresholds rise from 2027-01-01**: all new applications follow the new table (S$6,000 at age 23 and under, S$11,500 at age 45 and over; S$6,600 to S$12,700 for financial services). The old standard applies only to new applications lodged before 2027-01-01 and to renewals of passes expiring before 2028-01-01. This is the only policy date fixed with certainty in this record, and lodging should be scheduled around it.
官方资格页未列固定申请费；EP 的成本主要是雇主侧的薪资承诺，不是一笔签证费。本: The official eligibility page lists no fixed application fee; the cost of an EP is mainly the salary commitment on the employer side, not a visa fee. This record does not fill in a guessed amount.
官方资格页未给统一天数。实际时长受 FCF 招聘广告期、COMPASS 打分与材: The official eligibility page gives no uniform number of days. Actual timing depends on the FCF advertising period, COMPASS scoring and how complete the documents are.
用于 COMPASS 的学历项打分。中国学历通常需附英文翻译或学信网认证报告。: Used for the qualification item in COMPASS scoring. Chinese qualifications usually need an English translation or a CHSI verification report.
雇主 offer 与雇佣合同（含月薪）: Job offer and employment contract (including monthly salary)
月薪须达到按年龄对应的 EP 门槛，且是「固定月薪」口径。这是最容易卡住的一步：: The monthly salary must meet the EP threshold for your age, on a fixed monthly salary basis. This is the step where most applications stall: check the table for your age before negotiating salary.
雇主侧的 FCF 招聘广告证明: Evidence of the employer-side FCF job advertisement
雇主须先在 MyCareersFuture 刊登招聘广告并公平考虑本地候选人，才: The employer must first advertise on MyCareersFuture and fairly consider local candidates before lodging the EP application. This is not an applicant document, but it determines the timeline.
先按年龄查薪资门槛，再谈 offer: Check the salary threshold for your age before negotiating the offer
门槛按月龄分档：23 岁及以下 S$5,600，45 岁及以上 S$10,700: The threshold is banded by age: S$5,600 at age 23 and under, S$10,700 at age 45 and over, rising year by year in between. If the start date is in 2027, negotiate against the table effective 2027-01-01 (from S$6,000), or you may sign and only then find that you do not qualify.
确认 COMPASS 能不能过: Confirm whether COMPASS can be cleared
第一关过了不代表能申——还须通过 COMPASS 打分（除非豁免）。用 MOM: Clearing the first gate does not mean you can apply — you must also pass COMPASS scoring (unless exempt). Have the employer run the MOM Self-Assessment Tool first; that is less trouble than being refused later.
雇主完成 FCF 招聘广告: Employer completes the FCF job advertisement
雇主须先在 MyCareersFuture 刊登广告并公平考虑本地候选人，才能递: The employer must first advertise on MyCareersFuture and fairly consider local candidates before lodging the EP. This step usually takes 14 days and pushes the lodging date back directly.
雇主递交申请，等结果: Employer lodges the application and waits for the outcome
由雇主通过 MOM 在线系统提交。获批后准证绑定雇主与岗位。: The employer submits through the MOM online system. Once approved, the pass is tied to the employer and the position.
可续期，但续期同样要过薪资门槛。特别注意：2028-01-01 起到期的续期按新: Renewable, but renewal must clear the salary threshold again. Note in particular: renewals of passes expiring from 2028-01-01 are assessed against the new, higher table, so someone who qualified under the old threshold may fail at renewal when the threshold rises. The official wording is that the new standard applies to `renewal of passes expiring from 1 Jan 2028`.
EP 绑定雇主与岗位，换工作须重新申请。与 S Pass 的区别：EP 无配额、: The EP is tied to the employer and the position, and a change of job requires a new application. The difference from the S Pass: the EP has no quota and no labour levy but does have COMPASS scoring; the S Pass has a quota and a labour levy but no COMPASS.
薪资门槛按年龄分档，不是一个固定数字。23 岁 S$5,600、45 岁 S$1: The salary threshold is banded by age, not a single fixed figure. S$5,600 at 23 and S$10,700 at 45 — nearly double. Negotiating on the strength of 5,600 alone will likely waste the time of older applicants.
2027-01-01 起门槛上调一档（起薪 S$6,000、上限 S$11,50: From 2027-01-01 the threshold rises by one band (starting salary S$6,000, ceiling S$11,500). If an offer is agreed in 2026 but lodged in 2027, it is assessed against the new table — use the right table when negotiating.
续期会被新门槛追上：2028-01-01 起到期的续期适用新标准。现在刚好达标的: Renewal catches up with the new thresholds: renewals of passes expiring from 2028-01-01 follow the new standard. Someone who just qualifies now may no longer qualify in two years when the threshold rises.
FCF 招聘广告是硬前置：雇主没在 MyCareersFuture 刊登并公平考: The FCF advertisement is a hard precondition: without advertising on MyCareersFuture and fairly considering locals, the employer cannot lodge the EP. This adds about two weeks, and the applicant cannot control it.
与 S Pass 的取舍：达不到 EP 薪资门槛时，S Pass 是备选（门槛: The trade-off with the S Pass: if the EP salary threshold cannot be met, the S Pass is the fallback (thresholds from S$3,300), but the S Pass is subject to an employer quota and a labour levy, while the EP has no quota but does have COMPASS. The bottleneck differs: the EP stalls on salary and scoring, the S Pass on the employer quota.
Eligibility for Employment Pass（新加坡人力部官方: Eligibility for Employment Pass (official Ministry of Manpower page, including the salary band table)
两阶段框架原文：`To qualify for EP applications,: Two-stage framework, official wording: `To qualify for EP applications, candidates will need to pass a 2-stage eligibility framework`; `Stage 1 Earn at least the EP qualifying salary, which is benchmarked to the top 1/3 of local PMET salaries by age.`; `Stage 2 Unless exempted, pass the points-based Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS).`; the order is mandatory: `Candidates who do not meet stage 1 will not be eligible for an EP, regardless of the points they would have scored under COMPASS.`; FCF: `Employers must continue to meet the Fair Consideration Framework (FCF) job advertising requirement before submitting new EP applications.`; salary bands (non-financial sector) currently `$5,600` at age 23 and under and `$10,700` at age 45 and over, and from 2027-01-01 `$6,000` and `$11,500`; financial services currently `$6,200` to `$11,800`, new table `$6,600` to `$12,700`; scope: `Minimum qualifying salary for new applications from 1 Jan 2027, and for renewal of passes expiring from 1 Jan 2028`; the page was last updated on 2026-11-03.
